Description Take your favourite Huel Hot & Savory flavor on the road with the Reusable Huel Hot & Savory Pot! Made from BPA-free plastic, this super-practical pot allows you to mix Huel Hot & Savory whenever you don’t have a bowl to hand – simply add two level scoops to your pot, fill with boiling water to the line inside, stir thoroughly and seal with the pot’s sturdy screw-top lid. Please note: do not transport prepared Hot & Savory or boiling water in your pot. Details & Features BPA-free Screw-top lid Glossy black finish, with embossed matte Huel branding Holds up to 450ml liquid Internal measuring line Robust, heatproof design Dishwasher friendly How to Use Ensure Huel Hot & Savory pouch contents are mixed thoroughly Add two level scoops of Huel Hot & Savoury to your pot Fill to inside line with boiling water Stir thoroughly Cover with lid and leave for five minutes before eating Please note: do not transport prepared Hot & Savory or boiling water in your pot. About the manufacturer Our pots are made by Buchsteiner in Germany. They only use the highest quality raw materials that comply with all regulations regarding food contact, and are certified by independent laboratories. Delivery information For information on deliveries please see our delivery page here or for further information, contact us and we will do our best to help you. More questions? If you have more questions, checkout our FAQ page, or visit Huel's forum where you can search for similar questions or post your own.

Description Function, simplicity and durability are at the heart of what we do at Huel. So, we set out to find a blend of cotton and elastane that would balance functionality with softness. This shirt is tapered, has capped sleeves, and has a reinforced round neck. It will offer you unrivalled shape and feel and will surpass your expectations.Enjoy. Model is 5’10” tall, US size 8 and is wearing size Small. Wash cold | Tumble dry on low heat. Details Tapered fit (please note - if you prefer a looser fit, size up) Weight: 5.5oz. Material blend: Black 96% pre-shrunk, combed cotton; 4% elastaneGray 79% pre-shrunk, combed cotton; 15% polyester; 4% elastane Crew neck Capped sleeves Features Crisp white logo on left chest Vertical logo on rear neck Iconic fabric detailed side tab Reinforced neckline No laundry labels, for maximum comfort Washing and care Wash at 104°F Don’t bleach Tumble dry on low heat, but try and avoid Iron on low heat, avoid ironing prints Don’t chemical dry clean Size guide Size S M L XL XXL Length 24in 24.4in 24.9in 26.9in 27in Chest 33.9in 38.2in 42.1in 45.7in 47.7in Sleeve length 5.9in 5.9in 6.3in 6.7in 6.9in Length Measure the back of the t-shirt from the final neck stitching to the very bottom of the t-shirt. Chest Measure the widest part of your chest all the way around. Make sure to keep the tape horizontal. Sleeve length Measure the top edge of the sleeve from the seam to the end. Shipping information Shipping is free in the USA for all orders over $25. Shipping for orders under $25 is an additional $5. See our shipping questions page for more information. More questions? If you have more questions, checkout our FAQ page, or visit Huel's forum where you can search for similar questions or post your own.
